name: Compliance Posture Overview
description: Workbook showing policy compliance status, Defender Secure Score, and recent violations across the Azure estate.

sections.title: Policy Compliance Summary
sections.query: PolicyResources | where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates' | summarize count() by complianceState

sections.title: Recent Violations
sections.query: AzureActivity | where Properties has 'RequestDisallowedByPolicy' | top 50 by TimeGenerated

sections.title: Non-Compliant Resources
sections.query: PolicyResources | where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates' | where complianceState == 'NonCompliant' | summarize count() by resourceType
